storyTitle: Review Cash Value & Apply Statement Credits
oneSentenceStory: Customer reviews accumulated LBG coins and applies them directly as statement credits to reduce ongoing bills.
customerSituation: Customer visits the rewards overview to check balance and cashback earnings.
storyTension: Ensuring transparent cash-equivalent valuation and quick application without friction or gamified distractions.
customerResolution: Customer views clear statement credit options and allocates rewards directly toward bill reduction.
primaryOutcome: Direct visibility of cash-equivalent rewards and progress toward payment utility goals.
